hypothesis: A chronological policy improvement using realized causal teacher continuations is a better training objective for recurrent ENTER/WAIT/ABSTAIN and HOLD/EXIT than hindsight-best WATCH classification.
population: Existing Request171/178 BUY-gated positions, NOT full-HOT or full-market selection. No availability p75 gate is added in this isolated controller experiment.

fit.base_teacher: enter at first eligible state, exit at next observed decision
fit.student_targets: forced action now, thereafter frozen earlier-day teacher; never max realized future return

execution.source_timestamps: completed bar availability; same timestamp next bar open is execution reference only
execution.watch: first five observed states within five clock minutes
execution.why_29: source artifact has states 1..29; last observed row is never used as an implicit timeout
execution.missing_fill_or_exit: unresolved; invalidates day and gate, never cash
execution.entry_cost: BASE once per roundtrip; HOLD compares sell proceeds only

calibration: May11-20 eight existing dates, used ONLY for locked validation, no threshold fitting or offsets
development: June23-29 five already-opened dates, loaded only after calibration gate passes
forbidden: using future execution references as decision features
limitations: teacher cannot bootstrap arbitrary long-horizon value from nothing
one trade per episode; no reentry or shared capital
selection bias of BUY-gated source population remains
censored training targets reported but not economically identified
minute decision cadence with available second features; not continuous tick execution
